notes.title: Magic Borderless v1.00.5: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Ohayo!

This is an update to fix the notorious high CPU usage bug introduced from our last major update.

It turns out, it was simply the Magic scheduler not properly resting between loops when it needed to.

We deeply apologize for those who have been suffering from this issue. We will make sure to let this type of bug never crawl into Magic Borderless in the future.

[h1]Version 1.00.5 Update Notes[/h1][list]
     [*][b]Fixed the high CPU usage bug.[/b]
     [*]Fixed a crash when installations of steamapps folders were removed or otherwise moved.
     [*]Fixed a crash at start on certain machines.
     [*]Fixed a random crash while on low performance mode (when Magic Borderless is running in the background).
     [*]Fixed a bug on Steam game detection causing high CPU usage.
[/list]

If you run into any other problems, please feel free to stop by our forums and let us know!

Happy Magic Borderless gaming!

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.99.4.1 Update: Very Hot Fixes
notes.notes:
Ayo, gamers!
We hope you're grabbing some awesome games on this Summer Sale (and of course playing them)!

This is probably one of the most boring updates you'll ever see, but it was very important that we get this pushed as the game detection seemed to have serious issues with Java programs.

[b]v0.99.4.1[/b]
[list]
    [*]Magic Borderless now properly exits when the Steam client requests it to shutdown.
    [*]Fixed rare apps getting detected as "games" when it is graphical hardware-accelerated on slow computers.
    [*]Fixed all graphical hardware-accelerated Java apps getting detected as "games".
    [*]Fixed the application freezing when Steam was shut off unexpectedly (including crashes).
 [/list]

[b]Behavior changes to the Steam client shutting down[/b]
Magic Borderless used to freeze after Steam has shut down. This led to configuration corruption on rare cases. To prevent such tragedy, we are shutting the program down when Steam does.
We're not a huge fan of this behavior so if you also dislike this, don't worry! This is just a temporary workaround to freezing. Our solution to keep Magic Borderless running after Steam shuts down is already in the works, but we need more time. Because we didn't want our users to experience configuration corruption or freezes (without not knowing why), we had to implement this as an emergency patchwork.

We are, as we always have been, working really hard to bring you guys a bigger update. In the meantime, please enjoy this small package of hotfixes.

This update has passed all antivirus (AV) vendors tests available on VirusTotal. If you're still getting false positive alerts, please update your AV, in case you're still concerned.

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.99.4 Update: Improvements & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Good day, everyone!
We're here to improve the Magic further and fix some important bugs!

If you have missed our huge recent major update (v0.99), be sure to check them out first: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1022230/announcements/detail/1587996099243456528
Magic Borderless' ever growing compatibility is now even more improved to support games that are already borderless! Several improvements have been made to also work with some rare indie games.

[b]v0.99.4[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved the borderless algorithm to support more tricky games (mainly some indie games).
    [*]Improved window management to work on games with native borderless support without the use of Forced Override option.
[list]
    [*]This also adds support for Unity games with "-popupwindow" launch parameter! [i]Special thanks to [u]cutiebabie[/u] for testing a tricky Unity game for us![/i]
 [/list]
    [*]Improved font rendering to look clearer.
    [*]Improved spacing on App Wizard UI.
    [*]Improved optimization further.
    [*]Fixed fonts looking a bit blurry on large monitors with smaller resolutions.
    [*]Fixed Guard Powder infinitely resizing target window.
    [*]Fixed the configuration file getting saved unnecessarily. This was prone to configuration file corruption.
    [*]Fixed some tooltips expiring too soon.
    [*]Fixed Workshop menu staying disabled from an outdated value.
    [*]Fixed a crash when Windows audio service is disabled, or otherwise unavailable.
    [*]Fixed a rare crash on launch when a lot of apps are being launched on Windows starup.
 [/list]

This update has passed all antivirus (AV) vendors tests available on VirusTotal. If you're still getting false positive alerts, please update your AV, in case you're still concerned.

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.99.3 Update: MORE POWER!
notes.notes:
Waow! We're back already!
Yes, this minor update released a few days after our major update still adds new features to Magic Borderless.

If you have missed our huge major update, be sure to check them out first: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1022230/announcements/detail/1587996099243456528

We've added two new features that some games can definitely benefit from it, and further improved the game detection algorithm.

[b]v0.99.3 Update Notes (includes v0.99.1 notes as well)[/b]
[list]
    [*]Steamworks can no longer be disabled from now on. Magic Borderless will still function offline and before launching Steam.
[list]
    [*]We regret to inform you that this is stripped due to the large number of concerned users initiating refunds and leaving us negative reviews after they got false positive virus alerts.
    [*]Our Steam user review rating has notably dropped. Despite our best attempts to keep developing Magic Borderless with new features and improvements for free while offering a very low price for the product, this one false positive incident has only damaged the reputation we've built. Please note that our sales don't even cover any of the developers working hours.
    [*]This is very disheartening for us as well, so please accept our sincere apology. We will continue to explore our options to bring back the toggle while we wait for Steamworks to support unlinking running executable after necessary SDK calls have been made.
    [*]This, however, allows to spend more time developing features that could fully utilize Steamworks, and more new features while not having to spend time working on a version running with Steamworks disabled.
[/list]
    [*][b]Added delay time![/b] you can now set delay before Magic is applied to games that freak out when they are applied too soon (Under Night In-Birth: Late[st]).
    [*]Improved borderless algorithm to support more games.
[list]
[*]Improves the Magic effectiveness on GameMaker games (Undertale, Hero Siege, etc.). They should work at all times now.
[*]Improves the reliability of Calming Agent.
[/list]
    [*][b]Added new borderless mode[/b]. Originally, if you're not using custom sizing, it would expand to cover the original spaces used by the borders. It no longer does this by default, but we still gave you an option for it.
    [*]Further improved windowed game detection.
    [*]Updated Steamworks to the latest version.
    [*]Wizard window now has scrollbar for screen resolutions smaller than its  intended size.
    [*]Removed launching on a relative path of MagicBorderless from the launcher to avoid false positives from outdated antiviruses.
    [*]Fixed Respecting Taskbar always maximizing the windows regardless of sizing settings.
    [*]Fixed games that used to work not getting Magic applied anymore without Force Override option on.
 [/list]


[b]Regarding Virus Detection[/b]
On v0.99 we packaged some libraries into the executable hoping to reduce the file count, and created a separate launcher for Steamworks so people who wish to not have a permanent "playing Magic Borderless" on their status can still use the app through Steam.
However, this turned out to alert a lot of AVs for false positives. From this, we learned to delay our updates from now on to get our executable whitelisted by various AV vendors first before we push it to the public channel.
We have worked incredibly hard over the past week to ensure it no longer raises false positives.

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.99 Update: New upgrades, more cool options, & goodies!
notes.notes:
[i]For the hotfix: Update Notes for v0.99.1 at the bottom[/i]
Alakazam!
Heyo, everyone! 

Wait, what? A major update already?! Yes! And it's HUGE!

We're bringing some significant upgrades to Magic Borderless with brand new features and some [u]awesome improvements[/u] to the detection algorithms!
We call this the [b]MAGICAL UPGRADE UPDATE[/b], probably the biggest update yet!

In this update, we went back to the roots and further improved the "hassle-free" aspect of applying borderless. We made some significant changes to the the system so from now on, [i][b]Magic Borderless can detect WINDOWED GAMES![/b][/i]

Without further ado, let's get into the goodies!

[b]v0.99 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]Added Automatic Detection for Bordered Windowed Games[/b]. Magic Borderless will ask you if you want to add them to the configured list. Of all games we tested, it had 100% accuracy and zero false positives. Please let us know on the forums if you find any oddballs.

    [list]
    [*]When enabled (default on), it will prompt you to the configuration Wizard, or automatically apply your defaults if Auto-Apply option is on!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R1NYTtm.png[/img][/list]

    [list]
        [*]You can always disable them, but for maximum convenience we recommend having it turned on.
        [img]https://i.imgur.com/e9Kzbuv.png[/img]
    [/list]

    [*][b][i]Significantly improved target window algorithm.[/i][/b] This will now work on multi-window games (usually fan made mods or launchers) and properly filter out launchers, setting windows, loading popups, splash windows and whatever that's not the game screen.

    [*]Added [b]Compact UI mode[/b]. This will sacrifice some of the information displayed, but free up space to display more apps. 

    [list]
    [*]Smaller but more apps on a screen!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VYZ6PIt.png[/img][/list]

    [*]Added Fill Background which adds a background (default: black) to the target app. This is useful if you don't want any distractions on smaller sized windows. [b]Supporters (owner of any Donation DLC) can customize the background with the same editor we provide for skins![/b] Please note that Background customization is a global setting per user, and not part of a skin. For customization to load, Steamworks must be enabled.

    [list]
    [*]Look at that subtle off-Sans coloring. The tasteful thickness of it.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1YxEjeZ.jpg[/img]
    [*][i]Art by Dragoreon[/i]

    [*]Suppoters can create their own background. The button is located in the Wizard.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SMxiSW5.png[/img][/list]

    [*]Added Keep Aspect Ratio for maximizing windows so some games do not look stretched. This will work nicely with the new Fill Background feature.

    [list]
        [*]Keep the aspect ratio of the game window when maximizing!
        [img]https://i.imgur.com/1DkuCYC.png[/img]
    [/list]

    [*]Added Play Monitor option, a unique feature for multi-monitor users who like to switch where they play games on from time to time.

    [list]
    [*]When a monitor is selected to be a Play Monitor, any configured games with "Send it to Play Monitor" option enabled will be moved to that monitor. You can cycle through monitors to set them to a Play Monitor with a hotkey (Left Windows key + "O").

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GbLOu9Y.png[/img][/list]

    [*]Added Force Override. Magic Borderless now uses a smart algorithm to detect the game window before applying Magic. If it fails to detect the game window and skips applying magic, you can force the override.
    [*]Added a hotkey to restore Ninja Mode windows. It will only reveal one at a time.
    [*]Optimized the monitoring algorithm which vastly improves the performance and UI responsiveness.
    [*]Optimized the blinking animations further to help the main UI feel more responsive when there are a lot of windows running on integrated graphics cards.
    [*]Updated app information in the lists to show current window size and status of borderless magic (marked "★" when applied, or "☉" when borderless is done by the game itself.).
    [*][b]Magic Borderless Main Lab now remembers its window size.[/b]
    [*]You can now set window sizes smaller than 800 x 600.
    [*]Ignored games now have a red badge.

        [list]
    [*]Now we know which ones are REJECTED!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XptOlJG.png[/img][/list]

    [*]Games with invalid path (likely moved or deleted) now also have a greyed out badge. They also no longer display the placeholder icon.

        [list]
    [*]Oh noes, it doesn't exist anymore. Time to get it fixed!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ca1huCT.png[/img][/list]

    [*]The Lab (the main window) now changes the color of its title bar when the Magic is paused.
        [list]
    [*]But why would you ever want to pause MAGIC?!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fL0CkZY.png[/img][/list]

    [*]Pausing Magic now also disables all auto-detections.
    [*]Improved the overlay system used for Window Escape and backgrounds.
    [*]Improved filtering algorithm to exclude a rare type of invisible apps.
    [*]Improved quality of the app icons on the list to be more consistent.
    [*]Improved application scaling.
    [*]Changed default values (for new users) for Fullscreen App Auto-Detection to disabled, and Bordered Window Game Auto-Detection to enabled.
    [*]Fixed Auto-Detections kicking in while being configured.
    [*]Fixed audio pops and random sound effects being played at start.
    [*]Fixed changing to the correct path for missing apps not properly updating context menus.
    [*]Fixed volume controls and Window-Escape still being active with "Always Ignore" option on.
    [*]Fixed app settings not correctly synching after folder path has been reassigned, causing a minor memory leak.
    [*]Fixed excluded apps getting detected or getting magic applied.
    [*]Fixed apps with multiple windows not excluding other child windows when a new app is set to "exclude".
    [*]Fixed a brief jitter on the tray icon when Magic Borderless is launched.
    [*]Fixed a file saving error message not being displayed.
    [*]Fixed a crash when enabling Steamworks back.
    [*]Fixed a crash when a running app was removed from the settings.
    [*]Fixed a crash when changing the order of an app in a list of one item.
[/list]

If you have missed our last minor update, don't forget to check out the new volume management features:
        [list]
    [*]Easy and quick volume controls all in your hands!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tAYoeJH.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gkzzabA.png[/img]
 [/list]

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.98.5.1: Minor hotfix
notes.notes:
Yes, hello!

This is a very minor update to fix some UI issues on Windows with different scaling options.

We realize this is a very tiny update, but hopefully this answers any potential question on what was included in this  sudden update.

[b]v0.98.5.1 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added a potential fix for ugly font issues on different scaling options.
[/list]

We're currently working on two major features right now so don't get too disappointed! A new update is being worked on that will bring more exciting news in the future!

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.98.5: More Volume Control update
notes.notes:
How are you doing, everybody?

Oh yes, we're back! We decided to combine a few minor updates together to deliver you... a bigger minor update via this announcement!

From now on, we will be delivering minor update news on this official announcement channel as many of our users seem to miss them when they are posted on the forums.

Although it's considered a minor, this version still brings a new feature and improves the software.

[b]v0.98.5 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added App Custom Volume control. You can now control your app volumes on the [b]right click context menu[/b] from configured app list.
    [*]Updated Background Volume option to turn the option off entirely when it is set to 0.
    [*]Improved visuals of the separator lines on the context menu to work better with different menu colors (for Premium Skins). This style was already applied to the menu with v0.97.
    [*]Fixed app volume always returning to full volume.
    [*]Fixed various skin cache containing more than one skin, resulting a cache corruption. If your old skins no longer work, please contact us on our forums and we'll build one for you.
    [*]Fixed the main window not showing up in taskbar when "Start minimized in Tray" option was used.
[/list]

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.98 Update: More window management tools!
notes.notes:
Grüezi, Magic gamers!

After we added ways for you guys to customize some visuals from the last update, in this release we wanted to focus on providing various additional options that gamers find useful. Some of them were even requested features we got from the forums!

We would like to call this the first Swiss Knife Update, where we provide smaller tools to make Magic Borderless the best ultimate tool for windowed gaming!

We understand this update is not as big as everyone hoped, but there were some significant code changes which will help us bring little tools in the future.

[b]v0.98 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added Lower Volume/Mute In Background. This will lower the volume of your app or mute them if it is out of focus. When the app regains its focus, it will restore the audio level.
    [*]Added a new option for taskbar management. You can now completely hide Windows Taskbar. Note that Taskbar will only be hidden when you're using the selected app so they will be restored properly when they are out of focus. This can be also useful when Windows bugs out and still displays the Taskbar on full screen apps.
    [*]Added Cursor Reset shortcut in Tools. This helps when you lose track of your tiny cursor on your screen.
    [*]You can now drag apps on the app lists to change orders. Orders for running apps (on the left) will only remain valid in the same session, but configured apps (on the right) will remember their order.
    [*]Fixed a crash during a launch when a monitor is not properly initialized.
    [*]Fixed a crash caused by files in networked drives.
    [*]Fixed application icons not properly showing on rare unicode paths.
    [*]Fixed a very rare bug where the mouse lock would not initiate if the new window was detected while the magic is being processed.
[/list]

If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.97 Update: Custom skins (themes) & Workshop
notes.notes:
Heyo, everyone!

We're back with another major update that is unlike any other updates.
With v0.97, we're adding a feature to allow customization on the visuals of Magic Borderless a bit.
This was originally intended to be Donation-only feature, but we decided to give some of it to all owners of Magic Borderless.

First, there will be two types of skins available in Workshop: Basic Skins and Premium Skins, both created by our own users that can be shared to Workshop and used by anyone.

Basic Skins give you a way to change the background of Magic Borderless and adjust a few things. Premium Skins let you control more visuals and add more custom images. 

Secondly, Premium Skins can be used by anyone, but can only be customized and uploaded to Workshop by Donation DLC owners. Basic Skins can be edited or uploaded by anyone.

Lastly, we're adding a few new Donation DLCs that are cheaper than the current one available. [b]Any one of them will unlock your ability to create, modify and upload Premium Skins to Workshop.[/b]

Our intention is not to sell more features, but open up more ways for our users to support us further and give something nice in return as a token of appreciation. 

We want to make it absolutely clear here that any window management-related features for Magic Borderless will be added for free just like before. In fact, another major update is already being worked on.

Our software may increase in price as we add more features in the future, but those who already bought it will receive these feature updates for free.


[b]v0.97 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Magic Borderless now syncs Workshop mods in real-time. Restarts are no longer needed to add/update them. It will also-auto download your subscribed mods. Please note that if you unsubscribe any mod you're using (selected language or skin), it will revert to default.
    [*]Improved various parts of the menu UI.
    [*]Added Basic and Premium Skins for Workshop.
    [*]Added Silver and Gold tier Donation DLCs. Blue DLC is now known as "Platinum".
    [*]Added Basic Skin customization for everyone.
    [*]Added Premium skin customization for for any Donation DLC owners. [b]Premium Skins can be used by anyone (including non-Donation DLC owners) when downloaded from the Workshop.[/b]
    [*]Steamworks now immediately initializes on app start.
    [*]Crash logs are now created before the dialog is confirmed.
    [*]Fixed configuration file not becoming available on rare setups with cloud software.
    [*]Fixed Guard Power not working properly.
    [*]Fixed Respect Taskbar not working when no custom sizes (including maximizing) were used.
    [*]Fixed rare crashes when Magic Borderless was launched too early.
    [*]Fixed rare crashes when the tray icon is clicked while Magic Borderless is still building the UI.
    [*]Fixed graphical artifacts showing up on few buttons.
    [*]Fixed misalignment on target monitor setups.
    [*]Fixed rare crashes when Magic Borderless has not enough access to processes.
    [*]Fixed rare, odd behaviors with the top menu where they can instantly disappear or phantom-click on one of the options, changing the settings.
    [*]Fixed rare crashes when Magic Borderless was quit recently, and launched again while Steam was initializing Steamworks.
    [*]Fixed menu not displaying a check mark on selected mod (language).
[/list]

[b]Update Notes since v0.96[/b]
These were pushed as minor updates during the previous version's life cycle.
[list]
    [*]App running animation is now turned off when Magic Borderless Main Lab window is inactive to save some significant performance. It will be then replaced by a green orb to indicate whether an app is running or not.
    [*]Added Calming Agent, which is an another ingredient that you can add to the mix. This will help some of the older games that didn't work before. (Borderlands 1).
    [*]Replaced app running animation with a brand new animation to avoid confusion with "loading".
    [*]Improved borderless algorithm a bit for games that require Calming Agent.
    [*]Window-Escape on Return Mode now restores the mouse position upon re-entering the area.
    [*]Fixed Workshop version not getting updated in real-time.
    [*]Fixed Guard Powder getting retroactively applied (even if they are disabled) when dealing with certain window styles.
    [*]Fixed Ninja Mode not properly changing colors.
    [*]Fixed a crash with excluded apps.
    [*]Fixed excluded apps getting applied with previously configured settings.
    [*]Fixed menu key.
    [*]Fixed input validation error giving out errors on older version of settings.
    [*]Fixed Window-Escape overlay not being set properly when the app is running on non-primary displays.
[/list] 
If you are enjoying these updates, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further!

Always with love,

Studio Christmas.

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.96 Update: Window Positioning (w/ Monitor selector)
notes.notes:
Hello hello!
How is everyone doing on this fine day?

We're excited to announce the addition of a new feature that has been requested by many users of Magic Borderless! 
It's very versatile and we're sure our options would satisfy all of your needs in window positioning!

Window Custom Positioning is a new feature that allows you to position them anywhere you want. And yes, this also allows you to place them in other monitors!

As we add more options, it's inevitable we'll run out of space in Magic Wizard. We want to try to avoid using "tabs" or "pages". We improved a bit last update to accommodate more options and we updated again to even add more!
We did our best to not look the Wizard too complicated, but with a lot of features comes with a great amount of information all over the screen.
We're really hoping it doesn't look overwhelming.

Anyways, enjoy and here are some juicy changelogs:

[b]v0.96 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added window custom positioning (offsets).
    [*]Added nine alignment options for window positioning.
    [*]Added monitor targeting.
    [*]Added custom monitor labeling. You can set any custom label for your monitor to remember them better (in case you have same multiple monitors).
    [*]Added another mode for Window-Escape which resumes the window as soon as mouse enters the boundary again (without having to click the overlay once).
    [*]Added confirmation dialog for removing apps from the Configured App list.
    [*]Updated App Magic Wizard. To disable multi-item single selection toggles (like Mouse Lock), simply click the selected item again to disable it.
    [*]Fixed rare crashes on startup.
    [*]Fixed Window-Escape overlay not displaying on rare occasions.
    [*]Fixed failed Workshop mods removing the item.
[/list]

If you like Magic Borderless, please spread the word and give us a good review. It can really help us keep working on Magic Borderless further and bring you more exciting features!

We always appreciate your love and support.
Happy Magic Borderless gaming!

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.95 Update: Workshop support & TONS of goodies
notes.notes:
Yellow! How is everyone doing? :lunar2019piginablanket:

We've been working hard to get things fixed and add new things... This is [b]the biggest major update so far[/b] and there are some more new features planned after this!

And now it's finally here! We've added Workshop support for custom translations. You can change any text in the app to your liking, or translate them into other languages!

To begin translating, make a copy of the following file:
"<Magic Borderless installation folder>/Localization/main.yaml", 
open it in your favorite text editor and start translating by following the commented out guidelines.
After you save a new copy, simply go to Magic Borderless menu, and select "Steam > Workshop Tools > Upload Custom Translation" to upload your mod.

Magic Borderless tries its best to be self-explanatory at first glance. Due to this, the interface may seem a bit wordy sometimes. For Magic Borderless experts out there who already know how it works and wants to keep things simple, we've added Minimalist English. You can change them in the "Preference > Select Language" menu. 

Besides the custom translation support, we're also giving you guys the full control over the how you want to craft the borderless magic. Be sure to  check out the new App Magic Wizard!

We also added a temporary pause function for Cursor Lock. Currently it is bound to [Alt] + [C]. Sadly, key customization setting has not made it to this update. Don't worry though as they are still coming in the future!

We'd love to talk you through everything we added, but there are just a lot of additions in this patch so we invite you to see it yourselves:

[b]v0.95 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Steam client no longer reports Magic Borderless is running when Steamworks is disabled.
    [*]Auto-Detection no longer focuses the target app window upon pressing "AWESOME" button after it has been configured due to crashes with some apps.
    [*]Added Workshop custom translation support. Translation mods will not download/update if Steamworks is disabled!
    [*]Added "English - Minimalist UI" language setting.
    [*]Added a bunch of redundancies and internal restore point system to prevent file corruption when app is terminated while configurations are being saved.
    [*]Added two Spices (Persuasive Spice & Guard Powder) which you can both toggle individually. Hovering over their options will explain what they do in details. They were previously both enabled internally by default.
    [*]Added Revert option in the right-click context menu in case you want to restore the window from its magic. They can be reapplied from the same menu.
    [*]Added support for some peculiar games running on odd window styles.
    [*]Added Mouse Cursor Lock Boundary Reduction.
    [*]Added a temporary pause function for Mouse Cursor Locks. Hotkey: [Alt] + [C]
    [*]Added a Hotkey to apply default Magic to currently active window: [Ctrl] + [Alt] + [F7]  + [F8]. This will only work if the app was never configured. It also plays a sound effect when it's successful. We know the combination is ridiculous, but since it cannot be customized yet we wanted to absolutely make sure it doesn't accidentally get pressed.
    [*]Added a small dialog for new users. This will only appear once before confirming.
    [*]Added a sound effect to Auto-Detection.
    [*]Added more option to Mouse Cursor Lock.
    [*]Improved Mouse Cursor Lock algorithm to prevent movement stutters when the window becomes unresponsive.
    [*]Updated to App Magic Settings UI 2.0 (now App Magic Wizard 1.0) to accommodate more options.
    [*]Improved window life management to keep track of applications optimally.
    [*]Updated the warning dialog on disabling Steamworks.
    [*]Ninja Mode now also restores maximized states.
    [*]Fixed default settings changing on next startup on rare occasions.
    [*]Fixed Ninja Mode working on excluded apps.
    [*]Fixed windows not expiring from the list if the app makes use of hidden windows.
    [*]Fixed tooltips not showing up on some settings.
    [*]Fixed some games not showing up in the list.
    [*]Fixed installer missing .NET Framework 4.6.2.
    [*]Fixed odd behaviors with screen switching.
    [*]Fixed "Magic Borderless" not showing when hovering over the tray icon.
    [*]Fixed the 0.2 second delay on mouse cursor lock when a new window of a configured app starts.

We understand that this is a huge update and can be followed by some bugs we missed. As long as we are awake, we'll try to fix as fast as possible so please stop by our forums and let us know!

Thank you, as always, and happy Magic Borderless gaming!

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.94 Update: Harnessing the Dark Magic
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! :lunar2019piginablanket:

With your continued support and putting good words on Magic Borderless, we decided to never give up on games that are extremely stingy to work with. However, our results have been miserable ... until we decided to harness the Dark Magic.

Yes, with our latest update, Magic Borderless will be the first software to work on very tricky games like LET IT DIE. This improved magic has been tested to work with even more games than any other algorithm known to the mankind (probably). Don't worry, the Dark Magic* we harnessed is safe and legal.

We noticed there are some users who really wish to use Magic Borderless in their language. Sadly we couldn't afford any translators, but what we could do is to start working on Steam Workshop so the community members could help each other. It's not done yet, but we have started working on it. In preparation of the Workshop feature development we properly integrated Steamworks.

We would like to thank our beloved users who purchased our product. If you like Magic Borderless, we humbly ask you to leave a positive review and spread the words.

[i]*The Dark Magic we used actually does not do anything dangerous or risky or dark or resourceful or something bad according to our Dark Magic expert Derek.[/i] 

[b]v0.94 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Integrated Steamworks in preparation for custom translation Workshop support and Achievements. For those who do not want this, you can disable it to behave just like before.
    [*]Harnessed some ancient dark magic (but incredibly safe and legal) to significantly improve the compatibility of borderless magic. Such power can now even be used on extremely stingy games like LET IT DIE and use "non-standard" (e.g. uiltrawide) resolutions on tricky games like Pool Panic.
    [*]Items in the list now horizontally stretch, allowing you to click on the empty area to select them as long as it's on the same row.
    [*]Updated Magic Borderless app icon.
    [*]Updated some localization strings.
[/list]

[b]Update Notes since v0.93[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added an experimental (but safer) algorithm to save files as reports suggest Microsoft's default XML saving method can be unreliable. We didn't want to take chances.
    [*]Configuring it to "Ignore" now intuitively locks all other Magic controls in the Magic Settings windows.
    [*]Pressing "Esc" now clears the search bar and frees the focus.
    [*]Improved multiwindow process tracking algorithm.
    [*]Improved the strength of Window Magic on games that attempt to fix their resolutions when we apply custom window sizes.
    [*]Added tab navigation for when your mouse suddenly breaks out of nowhere and you can only use your keyboard or something. This is a built-in behavior of Windows UI. We just filtered out some unnecessary UI elements so you don't have to tab through them.
    [*]Added Hotkey label to the context menu as v0.93 removed the Ninja Mode tip.
    [*]Fixed a bug where if the app is ever migrated, a useless duplicate setting may be created in the file.
    [*]Fixed empty clones of windows showing up in the configured windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.93 Update: Two Major Updates Wtihin A Day?!
notes.notes:
Hello again! :lunar2019piginablanket:

If you have missed the update notes for v0.92, we encourage you to check them out as it adds [b]Exclude[/b] option for apps: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1022230/announcements/detail/1728723443012094724
How have you guys and girls been? It's been... a day since our last major update!

That's right. We are adding something cool this update called a search function. As your configured app list grows in size, we figured you may have hard time looking for the app.

Here we are with v0.93 with a search function that can help you become even lazier! No need to scroll through your configured apps anymore. Let's just search it.

[b]v0.93 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Borderless magic became so much smarter that it even works so well with some tricky games like GZDoom.
    [*]Added a search function for the configured apps list.
    [*]Added a counter that shows the number of excluded apps.
    [*]Added support for stingy games who are so protective of themselves that it wouldn't let us touch them. We taught Magic Borderless how to give them some space and still communicate with them.
    [*]Fixed crashes with stingy games.
    [*]Fixed default settings changing when quick-add was used in the session.
[/list]

notes.title: Magic Borderless v0.92 Update: New Exclude Feature!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! :lunar2019piginablanket:

First, we would like to thank everyone who has helped us find bugs and crashes from the forums.

With v0.92, we are adding a new feature that allows you to exclude any apps so they NEVER show up on the list again. Don't worry, we're also adding a small toggle to help you see excluded apps if you ever want to reverse your decision.

[b]v0.92 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added [b]Exclude[/b] option in the right-click context menu. You can exclude any apps you never want to see in the list again.
    [*]Added a toggle in the Preference menu to show excluded apps just in case you miss them so much.
    [*]Apps being customized with Default Settings no longer save sessions until you press confirm.
    [*]Expired windows no longer show up in the list.
    [*]Active windows are pushed to the top of the configured list.
    [*]Removed some overly redundant checks. 
    [*]Fixed apps being configured from default settings changing the default setting.
    [*]Fixed a crash when an app exits too early.
[/list]

[b]Update Notes since v0.90[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved live windows seeking algorithm to exclude invisible windows and hidden "suspended" Windows Store apps.
    [*]Improved window resizing. This may improve compatibility with more games, but depending on how the games were coded they may or not may not look distorted on games that preciously didn't support hotspot window size switches.
    [*]Added a note on custom window sizes as some apps do not support them.
    [*]Window resizing no longer depends on "borderless" option being on.
    [*]Taught Magic Borderless to stop freaking out on minor issues and crash like a noob.
    [*]Fixed a crash when the app is launched with invalid settings.
    [*]Fixed crashes when maximized option was turned off.
    [*]Fixed width & height options not working at all.
    [*]Fixed a minor memory leak. This may or may not have fixed our app becoming the largest memory horde in the history of pigs. Please let us know!
    [*]Fixed typos in English texts. Nobody in the studio read "Awway" and thought it was wrong.
    [*]Eliminated a few more potential memory leak causes.
    [*]Fixed a crash when some apps were terminated unconventionally.
    [*]Further improved stability.
    [*]Fixed a tiny bug no one knew about because it was so tiny.
    [*]Fixed Magic not being applied when the app enters a deepsleep mode (usually minimized to tray).
    [*]Enabled crash logger for internal crashes as well.
[/list]
